午.m: 7th earthly branch: 11 a.m.-1 p.m., noon, 5th solar month (6th June-6th July), year of the Horse; ancient Chinese compass point: 180° (south)

动.m: (of sth) to move; to set in movement; to displace; to touch

园.m: surname Yuan; land used for growing plants; site used for public recreation; abbr. for a place ending in 园, such as a botanical garden 植物园, kindergarten 幼儿园 etc

留.m: to leave (a message etc); to retain; to stay; to remain

长.m: long; (bound form) length; (bound form) strong point; forte; (bound form) to be good at

吧.m: bar (loanword) (serving drinks, or providing Internet access etc); to puff (on a pipe etc); (onom.) bang; abbr. for 贴吧

运.m: to move; to transport; to use; to apply

钱.m: surname Qian; coin; money; unit of weight, one tenth of a tael 两

记.m: to record; to note; to memorize; to remember

视.m: (literary, or bound form) to look at

呢.m: (sentence-final particle) used in questions to link back to prior discourse or context ("what about...?", "and...?"); (sentence-final particle) indicating that a state or situation still holds; (discourse particle) used to mark a slight pause or emphasis in speech; dense wool fabric (used for coats and jackets)

出.m: to go out; to come out; to arise; to occur; to produce; to yield; to go beyond; to exceed

非.m: abbr. for 非洲, Africa; to not be; not; wrong; incorrect; non-; un-; in-; de-

新.m: abbr. for Xinjiang 新疆; abbr. for Singapore 新加坡; surname Xin; new

分.m: to divide; to separate; to distribute; to allocate; to distinguish (good and bad); (bound form) branch of (an organization); sub- (as in 分局)

钟.m: surname Zhong; handleless cup; goblet; (bound form) to concentrate (one's affection etc); a (large) bell (CL:架)
